@@ -49,6 +49,46 @@ namespace AlgebraicGeometry
 
 attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
 
+/-! ## The `isLocalization_stalk` germ→local-cofactor bridge (reusable, scheme-general) -/
+
+/-- **Germ divisibility at a point gives a local cofactor outside the point's prime**
+(I-0305 §route step 2 (iii), the `isLocalization_stalk` wiring, general scheme form): on an
+affine open `U`, if the germ of `x` at `z ∈ U` lies in the principal ideal generated by the
+germ of `b`, then there is `r ∉ pz` (`pz = primeIdealOf z`) with `r · x ∈ ⟨b⟩` in `Γ(X, U)`.
+
+This is the pure-localization unpacking of stalk membership: the stalk `𝒪_z` is the
+localization of `Γ(X, U)` at `pz` (`IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk`, germ = `algebraMap`),
+so a germ cofactor `y = germ x / germ b` clears to `r · x = (a factor)·b` after multiplying by
+a denominator `∉ pz` and killing the localization kernel (`IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff`).
+The single-point escape valve feeding the RD-N support-avoidance reduction below. -/
+theorem IsAffineOpen.exists_notMem_primeIdealOf_mul_mem_span_singleton_of_germ_mem_span
+    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {z : X} (hz : z ∈ U)
+    {b x : Γ(X, U)}
+    (h : (X.presheaf.germ U z hz).hom x
+      ∈ Ideal.span {(X.presheaf.germ U z hz).hom b}) :
+    ∃ r ∉ (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩).asIdeal, r * x ∈ Ideal.span {b} := by
+  letI := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk (⟨z, hz⟩ : U)
+  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk (⟨z, hz⟩ : U)
+  set pz := hU.primeIdealOf (⟨z, hz⟩ : U) with hpz
+  set g := (X.presheaf.germ U z hz).hom with hg
+  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h
+  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
+  -- write the stalk cofactor `y` as a fraction with denominator `t ∉ pz` (germ = algebraMap)
+  obtain ⟨⟨a, t⟩, ht⟩ := IsLocalization.surj pz.asIdeal.primeCompl y
+  have ht' : y * g (t : Γ(X, U)) = g a := ht
+  -- clear denominators: `germ (t·x) = germ (a·b)`, so `t·x − a·b` dies in the stalk
+  have hzero : g ((t : Γ(X, U)) * x - a * b) = 0 := by
+    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, hy]
+    linear_combination (g b) * ht'
+  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff pz.asIdeal.primeCompl
+    (X.presheaf.stalk z) _).mp hzero
+  refine ⟨(m : Γ(X, U)) * (t : Γ(X, U)), ?_, ?_⟩
+  · exact fun hc => (pz.isPrime.mem_or_mem hc).elim m.2 t.2
+  · have hmt : (m : Γ(X, U)) * (t : Γ(X, U)) * x = (m : Γ(X, U)) * a * b := by
+      linear_combination hm
+    rw [hmt]
+    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨(m : Γ(X, U)) * a, by ring⟩
+
 variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
 variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
 variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {a : ℕ}
@@ -147,6 +187,39 @@ theorem notMem_support_chartColengthModule_of_forall_exists_notMem_mul_read_mem_
   · rintro c y _ ⟨r, hr, h⟩
     exact ⟨r, hr, by rw [smul_comm, h, smul_zero]⟩
 
+set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
+-- the germ into the heavy `relCurve` chart section-ring stalk re-elaborates the affine-open /
+-- localization instances past the defaults
+set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
+set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8 in
+set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in
+/-- **RD-N from single-point germ divisibility** (I-0305 §route step 2, the germ-level target):
+at a point `z` in the chart `V = relPinnedChart C R π b`, if for every `ψ ∈ K` the **germ** of
+`read ψ` at `z` lies in the principal ideal generated by the germ of `read s` in the stalk
+`𝒪_z`, then **RD-N proper** holds.
+
+This is the cleanest honest target the achiever hits: `read sec z` attains the base
+multiplicity at `z` (I-0291), so in the fibre DVR at `z` it has minimal order and its germ
+divides the germ of every reading.  The `isLocalization_stalk` bridge
+(`exists_notMem_primeIdealOf_mul_mem_span_singleton_of_germ_mem_span`) turns that germ
+divisibility into the local cofactor `r ∉ pz`, discharged by the support characterization
+above.  Single-point throughout; the degree obstruction (I-0305 §2) never fires. -/
+theorem notMem_support_chartColengthModule_of_forall_germ_mem_span
+    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
+    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) [Module.Finite R ↥K]
+    {z : relCurve C R} (hz : z ∈ relPinnedChart C R π b)
+    (hgerm : ∀ ⦃ψ : relThetaSections C R π a⦄, ψ ∈ K →
+      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (relPinnedChart C R π b) z hz).hom
+          (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) ψ)
+        ∈ Ideal.span {((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (relPinnedChart C R π b) z hz).hom
+          (relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s)}) :
+    (isAffineOpen_relPinnedChart C R π b).primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩ ∉
+      Module.support Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) ↥(chartColengthModule K b s) :=
+  notMem_support_chartColengthModule_of_forall_exists_notMem_mul_read_mem_span K b s hz
+    (fun _ψ hψ =>
+      IsAffineOpen.exists_notMem_primeIdealOf_mul_mem_span_singleton_of_germ_mem_span
+        (isAffineOpen_relPinnedChart C R π b) hz (hgerm hψ))
+
 end ThetaGeneratorSeed
 
 end AlgebraicGeometry
